newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips prices ASML offer at NLG 124.50.
newsitem.headline: Philips prices ASML offer at NLG 124.50.

text.p: Philips Electronics said on Thursday its previously announced offering of 3.95 million ordinary shares in ASM Lithography had been priced at 124.50 guilders per share.
Philips said the offering -- which will cut its stake in ASM Litho to 23.9 percent from 35.4 percent -- had raised a gross amount of 492 million guilders.
Philips had announced plans to cut its stake in ASM Litho by means of a public offering on January 23.
It said the price of the offering was the same as the January 29 closing price for ASM Litho's shares on the Amsterdam bourse.
ASM Lithography develops, makes and sells photolithography projection systems, known as wafer steppers, which are used to manufacture semiconductors.
The company's shares are listed in Amsterdam and on Nasdaq in the U.S.
Philips has said it plans to use the proceeds of the offering for "general corporate purposes".
ASM Litho was once a wholly-owned subsidiary of Philips. The electronics group has gradually reduced its stake since 1995 but has agreed to retain its current holding until March 2000.
